ANIMALS ACT 1953

ANIMALS (IMPORTATION) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 5(1) of

the Animals Act 1953 [Act 647], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Animals (Importation) (Amendment)

Order 2026.

Substitution of paragraph 2

2. The Animals (Importation) Order 1962 [L.N. 324/1962], which is referred to

as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended by substituting for paragraph 2

the following paragraph:

"Importation of

animals and birds,

etc.

2. Subject to the provisions of this Act, the MAQIS Act or

any other written law in force at the time of coming into

operation of this Order relating to entry points, animals or

birds, or any specified kinds of animals or birds specified in

column (2) of the First Schedule, originating from the

countries or parts of the countries specified in column (3)

may, subject to the restrictions specified in column (5),

be imported into Peninsular Malaysia and the Federal

Territory of Labuan for the purposes specified in column (4)

of the said Schedule.".

Substitution of paragraph 3

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for paragraph 3

the following paragraph:

"Prohibition on

importation of any

carcass, etc.

3. (1) The importation into Peninsular Malaysia and

the Federal Territory of Labuan of any carcass, semen, fodder,

litter, dung or any product of animals or birds or any article

or substance that is likely to convey or spread disease

specified in column (2) of the Second Schedule originating

from the countries or parts of the countries specified in

column (3) is prohibited.

 (2) Notwithstanding subparagraph 3(1), such carcass,

semen, fodder, litter, dung or any product of animals or birds

or any article or substance may, subject to the restrictions

specified in column (5) of the Second Schedule, be imported

into Peninsular Malaysia and the Federal Territory of Labuan

for the purposes specified in column (4) of the said Schedule.".

Deletion of paragraphs 4 and 5

4. The principal Order is amended by deleting paragraphs 4 and 5.

Substitution of First Schedule
